inherited_nonpriority_rule_differences.status: Unfixed concrete rule/qualification defects. Mandatory under whole Goal/Decision29; not accepted variants, optional gaps, or removed scope. Supervisor explicitly preserved frozen priority delta and directed next bounded repairs.

defects.counterexample: Source equips Chilongya; independent Fire chain damage root amount1/from_chain=true. Current native body adds1 -> canonical2, records DamageDealt2 and loses2 HP; source event.notLink() excludes reaction -> canonical1, DamageDealt1/HP loss1.
defects.restore_provider_consumer: Tag85 body qualification must reject an inadmissible from_chain recipient; exact equipped-card qualification/lifetime stays authoritative.
defects.minimum_test: Direct non-chain positive and real linked chain negative; First/ordinary native peers; byte/fullrestore before admission/body; compare event.num/HP/log/RNG and child suffix.

defects.counterexample: Zuijiu owner is damage source and d.card is Sha, but immediate root parent is another Damage root (chain), not genuine Sha intrinsic. Current filter still adds1; source requires event.getParent().name==sha and does not admit. Canonical amount/submitted HP/log and descendants differ.
defects.restore_provider_consumer: validate_trigger_bindings needs same genuine parent qualification at pre-execution admission; do not infer immediate parent from display/card names or requery provider after completed body while child awaits.
defects.minimum_test: Real Sha positive, linked independent root and card-labelled non-Sha immediate-parent negatives; source/root identity forgeries; byte/fullrestore at selection/admitted body/child; exact cost/RNG/log/suffix.

defects.counterexample: Recipient HP2, live Hutian deposit3, incoming canonical1. Source assigns hp-deposit=-1; current body uses cap.max(0) ->0. Both prevent HP submission, but later same-window handlers, canonical event.num, signed HOST_EVENT_AMOUNT bits, snapshot and progress/log observers see different quantity.
defects.restore_provider_consumer: Keep actual deposit/owner lifetime fact; signed negative canonical root must encode/hash/restore consistently and not be clamped or confused with receipt/HP loss.
defects.minimum_test: Positive cap, zero cap and HP below deposit negative cap; Last handler after priority-55 observes -1; signed VM read and byte/fullrestore before/after zero progression; exact HP/receipt/log/RNG.
